steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In July 2023, Equity Mates noted Ulta Beauty featured Barbie-themed products, from hot pink items to electric toothbrushes, as part of the movie lead-up. It positioned Ulta within a broad pop-culture merchandising push across major retailers.

episode.title: Barbie may be pink, but Mattel is seeing red

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In February 2023, Equity Mates observed that Ulta Beauty’s revenues were exceeding pre-COVID levels, highlighting ongoing recovery and business strength.
